thread:
Eve (CS): kicking off HarborWind private VPC onboarding checklist. goal: get network + IAM + KMS + audit logs green so we can flip traffic next Wed. small window, so want any blockers surfaced now. @Alice can you confirm the customer CIDR and whether they require egress via a centralized firewall?
Sam (SE): noted. will validate route table propagation and the NAT/FW path. quick q — do they want shared ENIs for steady throughput or single-tenant ENIs?
Alice (HarborWind): prefer shared ENIs for now, but we might switch to dedicated later. CIDR is 10.88.0.0/16. Egress must go through their on-prem firewall via transit gateway.
Nora (Network): ok, TGW + VPC attachment sounds good. I'll pre-provision route tables and a transit attachment in staging. need the on-prem public IPs for the firewall peer and the BGP ASNs.
Alice (HarborWind): sending IPs in DM. BGP ASN 65022.
Raj (Security): KMS and audit questions: do we bring our own CMKs or use Redwood-managed keys? also need to confirm S3 bucket for audit logs and retention policy. if BYOK, we'll need the key policy to allow cross-account decrypt for our log ingest role.
Alice (HarborWind): they want BYOK. retention 90 days for raw, 365 for processed.
Raj (Security): thanks. sample key policy snippet for BYOK cross-account allow (pls review):
```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Sid": "AllowRedwoodDecrypt",
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/Redwood-LogIngest"},
      "Action": ["kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey"],
      "Resource": "*"
    }
  ]
}
```
Raj (Security): also asking for a KMS key rotation cadence and whether HSM-backed key required. HSM needed?
Alice (HarborWind): HSM preferred but not strict for POC. rotation annually.
Sam (SE): IAM roles — we need the HarborWind deploy role ARN and a read-only cross-account role for their security team to view logs. RFC: we'll create a minimal role named HarborWind-Redwood-Deploy with the following trust policy.
```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [{
    "Effect": "Allow",
    "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::998877665544:root"},
    "Action": "sts:AssumeRole"
  }]}
```
Sam (SE): @Alice can you confirm the account ID for the deploy principal and whether they require session tags?
Alice (HarborWind): deploy principal is 998877665544. session tags: yes, include job_id and env.
Nora (Network): small network snag to flag: HarborWind's TGW already has an enforced prefix list that blocks 10.88.0.0/16 -> we need them to add our regional CIDR (172.20.0.0/16) to allowed prefixes or we won't be able to reach internal services. @Alice can you ask their infra team to add it?
Alice (HarborWind): pinged infra, they'll add by EOD.
Eve (CS): logging path — we'll push audit logs to HarborWind S3 in their infra via an assume-role. Raj, Sam: confirm the log bucket policy needs list/put object from our ingestion role and object-lock disabled.
Raj (Security): correct. also enable S3 server-side encryption with the BYOK CMK and set bucket lifecycle to move raw logs to Glacier after 90 days. I can draft the bucket policy if helpful.
Sam (SE): please do. after that I'll run a quick smoke using the deploy role to confirm permissions. I'll post the smoke command here.
Sam (SE): smoke command (dry-run):
```bash
aws s3api put-object --bucket harborwind-audit --key test/ingest-ok --body /dev/null --profile redwood-ingest
```
deploy-bot: run 2026-03-16T17:02:01Z - smoke test started by Sam (SE).
Sam (SE): ran that against staging — got 403 on PutObject, so current bucket policy is blocking our role. Raj / Alice, can you triage?
Raj (Security): looking. preliminary fix: add ARN arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/Redwood-LogIngest to the bucket policy and verify s3:PutObject and s3:PutObjectAcl allowed.
Alice (HarborWind): policy update scheduled in 30m. will confirm when complete.
Eve (CS): thanks. small renewal note for account health: HarborWind is on a quarterly reserved capacity trial. if we miss cutover next week there's a risk they delay the reserved commitment by a quarter. marking renewal risk as "medium" until cutover completes. will document in the account playbook.
Nora (Network): action items I have: provision TGW attachment in staging, update route tables, and verify peering BGP. ETA tomorrow AM.
Sam (SE): action items: prepare IAM trust & permissions, run ingest smoke, and validate token exchange. ETA tomorrow noon.
Raj (Security): action items: final KMS policy, bucket policy, and rotate key permissions. ETA tomorrow EOD unless BYOK handover earlier.
Eve (CS): great. next sync: 10:00am PST tomorrow — we'll take signoffs and decide go/no-go. please react :thumbsup: when you ACK your items.
Alice (HarborWind): acked :thumbsup:
Nora (Network): ack :thumbsup:
Sam (SE): ack :thumbsup:
Raj (Security): ack :thumbsup:
Eve (CS): closing for now, I'll post updated playbook entries after infra confirms the prefix-list change. thanks all.
